_help: Edit topics and keywords freely. arxiv = arXiv API search_query syntax (abs: abstract, ti: title, AND/OR, quotes for phrases). Items already shown are never repeated.

topics.name: Federated learning: vehicles, edge, communication
topics.arxiv: abs:"federated learning" AND (abs:vehicle OR abs:vehicular OR abs:automotive OR abs:edge OR abs:"communication-efficient" OR abs:quantization OR abs:sparsification)

topics.name: Small and efficient language models
topics.arxiv: ti:"small language model" OR (abs:"language model" AND (abs:pretraining OR abs:"from scratch") AND abs:efficient)

topics.name: Edge AI, pruning, quantization
topics.arxiv: abs:tinyml OR (abs:"edge devices" AND (abs:pruning OR abs:quantization)) OR (abs:"large language model" AND abs:pruning)
